summary: The page displays minor alignment and contrast issues, particularly within the dialog layout footer and table header contrast.

issues.title: Asymmetrical inner layout
issues.description: Left-side plan badge column is misaligned with the primary content block, creating awkward spacing.
issues.evidence: The isolated 'P' icon, 'Pro plan', and price are vertically stacked awkwardly to the left of the main text and action buttons.
issues.suggestion: Restructure into a standard vertical stack or balanced horizontal card.

issues.title: Low contrast text in table header
issues.description: Subtext beneath the column header has insufficient contrast against the dark background.
issues.evidence: The '$99/mo' text under 'Scale' is very dim and hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase font opacity or brightness for dark mode legibility.
